revenue_scope: Novelion's 'Lomitapide' row of its net-revenues-by-product-and-geography note: JUXTAPID product sales in the U.S., Japan, Brazil and other foreign countries, plus royalty revenue on sales of lomitapide by the licensee of the territories out-licensed in December 2016 (the 2018Q2 release identifies $0.8 million of that quarter's JUXTAPID net revenues as royalties on Amryt's EMEA sales)
geography: Worldwide except the European Union and certain other jurisdictions out-licensed to Amryt in December 2016, where only royalties are booked
why_separate: Aegerion's gold series (2013Q1-2016Q3) is Aegerion's global net product sales of Juxtapid including its own sales in the EU. Aegerion out-licensed the EU and certain other jurisdictions to Amryt in December 2016, after which Novelion books royalties and milestones for those territories instead of product sales and reports 'net revenues' rather than 'net product sales', so the scope of the line changed at the ownership change and it is not spliced onto the series.
notes: Novelion acquired Aegerion on 2016-11-29. Fourth quarter 2016 is not in this file: Novelion's Q4 2016 release (0000827809-17-000006, Exhibit 99.1 nvln-12312016pressrelease_.htm) prints GAAP JUXTAPID net product sales of $8.6 million for 29 November-31 December only and pro forma $22.4 million for the whole quarter, a pro forma that predates the Amryt scope change, so it is neither a full reported quarter nor the continued line. Rows are Novelion's lomitapide net revenues from the 10-Q and 10-K table row; 2017Q4 and 2018Q4 are the 10-K full year less the 10-Q nine months (the Q4 2017 release's one-decimal 20.1 is not used, so no row mixes sources). The line continues under Amryt Pharma from 2019Q4 on a global scope that includes EMEA product sales; that is sourced in the companion amryt_juxtapid_cont and is not joined to this file. Novelion filed NT 10-Q forms for 2019Q2 and 2019Q3 and no later periodic report. Sums: 2017 = 16.024+20.713+15.192+20.2 = 72.129 against the 10-K's 72,130 thousand; 2018 = 13.390+16.272+14.250+15.186 = 59.098 against the 10-K's 59,072 thousand (a 0.026 million difference, not explained here).
search_log: Novelion (CIK 827809) filing list read via data.sec.gov: 10-Qs and 10-Ks for 2016-11 to 2019-05 and Item 2.02 8-K releases 2017-01 to 2019-05 opened; after the 2019-05-07 10-Q the list shows 8-Ks, NT 10-Q (2019-08-12, 2019-11-15), a 25-NSE (2019-12-17) and a REVOKED order (2023-03-10) and no later periodic report.

Releases for 2017Q1-2018Q2 print 'net revenues of JUXTAPID' in prose; the Q3 2018, Q4 2018 and Q1 2019 releases print no JUXTAPID amount, so the 10-Q/10-K lomitapide table row is used for every quarter (2017Q4 is derived from the 10-K).

Scope check: Novelion Q1 2017 10-Q states 'In December 2016, Aegerion out-licensed the rights to commercialize LOJUXTA in the EU and certain other jurisdictions to Amryt Pharma plc ... and will receive sales milestones and royalties on net sales in those jurisdictions'; the 10-K for 2018 states Aegerion transferred the Europe marketing authorization for LOJUXTA to Amryt in July 2018.

Amryt Pharma (CIK 1783010) reports were read for the successor line and are sourced in the companion amryt_juxtapid_cont; whether Aegerion's pre-2016Q4 sales included a Europe component by quarter was not checked.
